pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (evaluation order and the exponentiation exceptions, mode-independent), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 (32-digit standard intermediate) and §2002:8.8.1.3.1.3 (rounding to 31 digits on compare, on a function argument with no equivalent expression, on a store without ROUNDED), §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation), and §2002:15 / §2002:15.1 (the same six function types; 2002 15.1 says the definition gives an alphanumeric/national function's character positions). Trailing-space truncation is the function's own rule; no arithmetic. The further clauses §2002:8.8.2 (boolean expressions), §2002:8.8.4.1.1 (relation conditions) and §2002:8.8.4.2.4 (abbreviated combined relations) govern relation conditions in procedure statements; this function's comparison is defined by its own returned-value rules, not by 8.8.4.1.1, so they do not reach the rule.
